vendors.program_name: Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Program (MAICPP) — Cloud Solution Provider (CSP) model + Solutions Partner for Business Applications designation
tiers: Cloud Solution Provider (CSP): Indirect Reseller (no revenue minimum) / Direct Bill (requires $1M trailing-12-month revenue in FY26)
Solutions Partner designations across 6 solution areas (incl. Business Applications for Dynamics 365/Power Platform), each requiring a Partner Capability Score of 70/100

FY27 customer-facing commercial solution areas renamed AI Business Solutions, Cloud & AI Platforms, and Security; System Integrator (SI) and Managed Service Provider (MSP) tracks continue with their own incentive programs
FY27 additions: Agentic Partner Capability Score; Frontier partner specialization; Frontier Transformation Engineer badge
vendors.program_structure_note: Microsoft retired the old Gold/Silver competency model in October 2022 in favor of solution-area 'Solutions Partner' designations (e.g., Solutions Partner for Business Applications) earned via performance, skilling, and customer success points rather than a linear tier ladder.
vendors.revenue_share_range: FY27 (Jul 1, 2026–Jun 30, 2027): Dynamics 365 incentives shift from flat run-rate rebates to premium-SKU Strategic Product Accelerators plus a year-on-year Growth Accelerator; Sherweb analysis states up to 19.5% earning opportunity, while Microsoft does not publish a Dynamics-specific rate table. New FY27 Frontier Accelerate incentives cover Copilot, Business Processes, and AI-Ready Productivity portfolios and require a 33% portfolio performance rate, measured at quarterly milestones over the 12 months after each engagement. MSPs can earn 15% Partner Earned Credit on managed Azure consumption.

deal_registration.protection_period: Managed via Microsoft co-sell and referral programs; in FY27 Azure IP co-sell is Marketplace-first and PRACR is no longer the broad co-sell mechanism; specific protection period not publicly disclosed

mdf_available.notes: MDF available through the Partner Incentives program, tied to designation level and co-sell performance

vendors.certification_cost: Individual Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 exams typically ~$165 USD each; FY27 Business Applications skilling updates replace MB-280 with AB-210, Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations/Supply Chain solution-architect skilling with AB-100, PL-200 with AB-410, and MB-240 with AB-250 for affected designations/specializations. On August 31, AZ-500 retired for SC-500 and PL-200 retired for AB-410; completed retiring certifications remain valid for one year.
vendors.annual_partner_fee: Not a flat fee — gated by revenue thresholds; Direct Bill CSP requires $1M+ trailing-12-month cloud revenue in FY26 (raised from a prior ~$300K/year bar), per Novistra Capital ecosystem report
vendors.ecosystem_size: 500,000+ partners across the overall Microsoft Cloud Partner Program ecosystem (not Dynamics-specific); more than 1,500 partner businesses hold Microsoft's diverse/minority-owned certification (per CRN)

recent_program_changes.change: Microsoft retired AZ-500 and PL-200 certifications for affected partner designations and specializations, replacing them with AI-focused SC-500 and AB-410; certifications completed before retirement remain valid for one year.

Microsoft introduced the Eligibility Dashboard for CSP direct-bill partners. MAICPP enrollment and the security requirement are validated at the tenant level, while the $1M TTM revenue requirement, active support plan, and Solutions Partner designation remain PGA-level requirements.

Sherweb's August Dynamics update reports new FY27 Frontier Accelerate incentives for AI Business Solutions across Copilot, Business Processes, and AI-Ready Productivity; partners must maintain a 33% portfolio performance rate measured at quarterly milestones over the 12 months after each engagement.

Microsoft updated customer-facing Solutions Partner badge names to align with three commercial solution areas: AI Business Solutions, Cloud & AI Platforms, and Security; eligibility for benefits and incentives remains tied to the enrolled solution path.

Third-party Sherweb analysis of FY27 CSP incentives says Dynamics 365 moves to premium-product Strategic Product Accelerators plus a year-on-year Growth Accelerator, with earning opportunity up to 19.5%; flat run-rate rebates are retired and exact SKU rates remain unpublished.

CRN interview with Microsoft's Chief Partner Officer details FY27 additions: Agentic Partner Capability Score accelerates eligibility for incentives and badges; Frontier partner specialization and the frontier transformation engineer badge are positioned as top-tier AI credentials. No new percentage payout is disclosed.

Microsoft Partner Center updated FY27 specialization skilling: Dynamics 365 Customer Experience Analyst (MB-280) retires for Sales AI Consultant (AB-210); Power Platform Functional Consultant (PL-200) retires for Intelligent Applications Builder (AB-410); Field Service (MB-240) retires with Contact Center AI Engineer (AB-250) added; Business Applications advanced skilling adds Agentic AI Business Solutions Architect (AB-100).

Microsoft at 50 blog detailed current partner ecosystem structure: ISV Success pathway for software companies, Solutions Partner designations and specializations tied to go-to-market resources and incentives

Novistra Capital ecosystem report: Microsoft tripled the minimum trailing-12-month revenue bar for Direct CSP partners to $1 million/year (from ~$300K) and added mandatory 'Solutions Partner' designation requirements in areas like Security and Modern Work

Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Program added high-value specializations (Copilot, Sovereign Cloud) and boosted co-sell incentives — 50% more Copilot funding and 70% more Azure Accelerate investment for FY26
Microsoft Tech Community post on the growth engine for partners: Business Central, AI, and partner-to-partner (P2P) motions as a new focus area for MSPs and Business Applications partners
